summary: Wrote a 7-phase, 11-hour plan implementing the research report's eight decisions as one general error-logging mechanism: correct rules/error-handling.md to name issue-record.sh (the store actually written) instead of the abandoned errors-append.sh, add one infrastructure/transport-unavailable seed class to issue-log.md and to issue-record.sh's duplicated ISSUE_SEED_CLASSES array, document a general tags.occurrence collapse convention plus a 10-citation render cap at the conclusion stage, and add a new scripts/lib/central-log-lib.sh that pushes error-bearing lines from both shared writers to specs/central-errors.jsonl in the owning repo under flock with a single-generation rotation bound and an owning-repo skip. Sapience is implemented strictly as a subclass: sapience-retrieve.sh gains an exit-code split (genuine HTTP/transport failure vs benign zero-hit) so capture does not flood the log, and the non-capturable MCP-tool class is documented as an accepted gap. Every carried figure in the dispatch description was re-measured and confirmed; all 23 Files-to-modify paths harvest cleanly including the __WHOLE_TREE__ sentinel on the redeploy phase, and validate-artifact.sh passes with 0 warnings.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan (4 dependency waves, 11 hours) for the error-logging contract correction, the infra-unavailable class, the general collapse rule, the push-based central log, and Sapience as a subclass.
